description: This Java source file defines the final class 'ModifyPolicyId', which implements a command to modify the Policy ID of a Thing object in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating commands from parameters or JSON, retrieving the new Policy ID, resource path, and other metadata related to the command.

classes.name: ModifyPolicyId
classes.description: A command class that modifies the Policy ID associated with a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides mechanisms for creating such commands from parameters or JSON representations, retrieving the modified Policy ID, and serializing command data.
